boundAssumption: Only GPU time changes; all measured host work held fixed. This single instrumented shared-Mac workload is not an architecture-wide ceiling or an Ollama-comparable TPS prediction.
selectedBatch: Connect existing E4 plus hardware-derived Q4 launch selection/production artifact into normal model compile/inference, bind actual installed backend state, reuse-only inference. No new arithmetic, no relaxed gates.
expectedGain: No promised TPS or percentage. Previous E4/Q4/attention diagnostics suggest substantial gain, but new matched evaluation must decide. Intrusive shares cannot become normal GPU shares.
modelBackendLayout: Same 14.44GB GGUF kept for fair comparison; execution schedule identified as actionable. MLX/layout causality not measured and no conversion/download undertaken.
measurementWarmup: First generation after a two-token prefill, without a full-generation warmup. These shares may include cold page/resource effects; they are not a stable warm serving budget. The later intrusive replay was primed by that generation.
